decisions.reason: The source permits an alternative production part only for the passive buzzer; it does not change the selected LED, its electrical interface, or its LCSC part.
The buzzer sourcing decision does not alter the sensor-board connector matrix or connector count.
The source concerns selection of a passive buzzer part and does not affect the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The passive-buzzer part policy has no effect on the panel reset connector, mounting, or electrical action.
The source does not change any panel button, switch, connector, or GPIO assignment.
The source is specific to a buzzer prototype and possible LCSC substitute and does not affect the PIR interface.
The permission to substitute the buzzer does not change the LED-array count or its selected LCSC LED part.
The buzzer sourcing decision does not alter the capacitive-touch sensors, connectors, or GPIO assignments.
The source gives part-selection latitude for this specific buzzer but does not modify the existing USB-connector sourceability rules or establish that those rules now apply unchanged to buzzers.
Selecting or substituting the passive buzzer does not change the monitored rails, INA219 topology, or spare monitoring channels.
The source does not alter the interboard power topology, connectors, or pinout requirements.
The buzzer part-selection policy does not change the interboard signal connectors or signal pinouts.
